_schema.products: array of exactly 10 entries, one per approved blank type

entry_fields.key: short stable slug for this blank, e.g. 'unisex-tee'
entry_fields.label: human name, e.g. 'Unisex Heavyweight Tee'
entry_fields.blueprint_id: Printify blueprint id (integer) — from Printify catalog
entry_fields.print_provider_id: Printify print-provider id (integer) for that blueprint
entry_fields.art_version: 'transparent' | 'parchment' — which art file prints on this blank
entry_fields.variant_ids: array of Printify variant ids to enable (sizes/colors)
